parts.final:
Linearity: Non-linear for all $a$ (due to $\cos(2\pi n)$ term).
Stability: BIBO stable for $|a| < 1$, unstable for $|a| \ge 1$.
Causality: Causal for all $a$.
Time-invariance: Time-variant for all $a$ (due to $\cos(2\pi n)$ term).
Memorylessness: With memory for all $a$ (due to $y[n-3]$ term).
